data.body: Investigation: ROOT_CAUSE confirmed. migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh writes DESIGN.md + tombstones .claude/design-notes.md but has zero git operations. All 7 calling Migration Check blocks (fix-bug, debug-everything, brainstorm, sprint, roadmap, preplanning, onboarding SKILL.md) run it via `bash $PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh 2>/dev/null || true` with no staging/committing afterward. Fix: add git add + git commit (plain, no --no-verify) for the two affected files at the end of the migration path, wrapped in || true for silent-fail in restricted contexts.
